security_audit.summary: All 14 static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, documentation links, or ordinary Motoko code. One high-severity consent flaw remains: the example enrolls users in marketing without a separate, explicit opt-in.

remediation.issue: Registration automatically adds users to a marketing topic and bundles marketing consent with required email verification.
remediation.suggestion: Require a separate unchecked marketing opt-in, record consent, and subscribe only after verification and explicit confirmation.

content.value_statement: Marketing email systems need verified recipients, controlled sending, personalization, and reliable unsubscribe handling. This skill provides Motoko patterns and Caffeine AI modules for those workflows.
actual_capabilities: Defines topic creation, renaming, removal, lookup, and subscriber counting through the prefabricated subscribers module.
Subscribes and unsubscribes authenticated users using their stored email addresses.
Selects verified subscribers for a topic before sending a campaign.
Supports recipient-specific template substitutions for personalized email content.
Adds an unsubscribe placeholder when the supplied HTML body omits one.
Demonstrates admin authorization for topic management, subscriber listing, and campaign sending.
limitations: Requires Caffeine AI email, authorization, email verification, and email marketing Motoko packages.
Provides backend patterns only, without a campaign editor or subscriber management interface.
The example requires redesign because registration automatically enrolls users in a newsletter.
Does not cover scheduling, analytics, bounce handling, rate limits, or delivery monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the Modules
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how the subscribers, verification, authorization, email client, and unsubscribe modules work together in a Caffeine AI marketing workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter Backend
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Motoko backend for a newsletter named [TOPIC]. Require explicit opt-in, verified email, admin-only sending, personalization, and unsubscribe links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a basic compliant campaign workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Add Topic Administration
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend my Motoko actor with admin-protected topic creation, renaming, removal, subscriber counts, and verified subscriber listing using the prefabricated modules.
prompt_templates.scenario: Add operational controls to an existing application.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Campaign Implementation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Motoko marketing backend for consent, authorization, verified-recipient enforcement, HTML safety, unsubscribe behavior, error handling, and data exposure: [IMPLEMENTATION].
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced security and compliance review.

output_examples.input: Design a verified product newsletter with explicit opt-in.
output_examples.output: A backend design separating registration, email verification, marketing consent, topic subscription, admin sending, and unsubscribe processing.
A recipient plan mapping each verified subscriber to a NAME substitution while preserving the required unsubscribe placeholder.

output_examples.input: Review who can send and inspect campaigns.
output_examples.output: An authorization review confirming admin checks for sending, topic changes, and subscriber listing, with public self-service subscription endpoints.

best_practices: Collect explicit marketing consent separately from account registration and email verification.
Send campaigns only to subscribers who remain opted in and have verified email addresses.
Protect sending, topic management, and subscriber inspection with server-side admin authorization.
anti_patterns: Do not enroll every new account in marketing topics by default.
Do not store duplicate subscription state outside the prefabricated subscribers module.
Do not send marketing HTML without the unsubscribe placeholder.

faq.question: Which language and platform does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Motoko backends using Caffeine AI email, authorization, verification, and marketing packages.

faq.question: Does the skill verify email addresses itself?
faq.answer: It integrates the Caffeine AI email verification modules and selects verified subscribers before campaign delivery.

faq.question: Can campaigns personalize messages?
faq.answer: Yes. Each recipient can receive named substitution values that replace matching placeholders in the email body.

faq.question: Are unsubscribe links supported?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow uses an unsubscribe mixin and ensures the email body contains the required unsubscribe placeholder.

faq.question: Does the example provide compliant consent handling?
faq.answer: No. Its default newsletter enrollment should be replaced with a separate, explicit marketing opt-in.

faq.question: Does this skill include campaign analytics or scheduling?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on subscriber topics, verification, personalization, authorization, sending, and unsubscribe handling.
